body:
The web has oxlint and Android has AGP lint, but the server has no linter or
formatter at all — the only Python gate is pytest.

Adopt, as server dev dependencies and as a stage in verify-all.sh:

- black   — formatter, and the authority on layout
- isort   — import ordering, configured profile="black" so black wins every
            disagreement (explicit user instruction: black has priority)
- ruff    — linter only (no formatting, no import sorting; black and isort own
            those), so its rule selection must not fight them
- ty      — type checker (Astral, early preview)

Formatting the existing tree is a large but mechanical diff; keep it in its own
commit, separate from the config, so the config change stays reviewable.
title: Python linting: ruff + ty + black + isort, wired into verify-all
